messages:
Rina (sec-eng): Quick note: running a "rights sanitization" run this Sunday 03:30 UTC. goal: compress admin memberships, collect KMS grant evidence, and produce an auditable package for compliance. prefer non-destructive first pass (shadow + evidence). Mark (infra): I can own the KMS side. will look for grants >120d and principals with no API activity in 60d. plan to output CSV + key policy snapshots. Theo (platform): I'll hook this into CI and add a --shadow flag. prefer we avoid direct removals; move folks to shadow-admins group for 7 days. dry-run command I'll use: ``` ./bin/entitlements report --role=admin --age=120 --format=csv --dry-run ``` Artifacts -> s3://redwood-sec/rights/5298765432/ Rina (sec-eng): please include columns: principal, principal_type, last_api_call, last_token_issue, shadow_until, evidence_link. Mark: also add `kms_last_decrypt` and `policy_snapshot_link`. Mark (infra): ack. I'll also flag principals that have static keys or long-lived tokens in `flags`. uploading initial CSV in a few mins. oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance window Sun 03:30-04:30 UTC. Suppressing non-actionable pages. Theo (platform): post-shadow smoke tests: deploy-canary, secret-rotation, billing-read. If smoke fails for a principal, mark as `restore_candidate` and run: ``` ./scripts/restore_binding --principal

--ttl 2h ``` I'll add a one-click rollback link to the generated PR. Rina (sec-eng): Important: run an audit-log replay (last 180d) for principals we touch and redact emails/ips before bundling for compliance. Also include a small vuln sweep: tag principals connected to images/agents older than 90d. Mark (infra): will add `vuln_notes` with CVE links when available. will include `policy-diff.tar.gz` per key. Theo (platform): CI will create a PR with the shadow list and an evidence bundle. Dry-run will annotate suspected service vs human accounts via `last_token_issue`. Rina (sec-eng): process: 1) run dry-run and review CSV 2) 20-min triage on the shadow candidates 3) apply shadow move 4) run smoke checks 5) publish evidence bundle and redact PII. If anything looks like it will break production, restore immediately. Mark (infra): ACK. I'll be on call for rollback creds. Theo (platform): ACK. I'll ensure rollback scripts are tested in staging. audit-bot: Run created: 5298765432 (status: queued). Link: https://audit.redwood.internal/runs/5298765432 Rina (sec-eng): thanks all. ping `#eng-security` if you spot risky principals early. I'll DM any high-risk findings.
